thread:
Riley (CSM): Quick capture from this week's renewal + enablement sync. Three recurring asks from customers on trials/renewals: 1) clearer per-route cost attribution in billing exports, 2) a console "embeddings quick-check" button that runs a small sample prompt, 3) better visibility into what happens when Dedicated capacity is degraded (customers saw silent retries).

Lee (Renewals): two renewals flagged because finance teams couldn't reconcile charges. If we can't show per-route totals they push renewals back.

Jordan (Product PM): noted. Do we have examples of the CSV shape customers expect?

Riley (CSM): quick example one of them sketched: 
CSV header: account_id,route,request_count,avg_latency_ms,total_tokens,cost_usd
They want route-level totals and a human-friendly name for routes (not UUIDs).

Tasha (Solutions Eng): for embeddings quick-check: we can wire a button to run one call against a cheap model and display similarity scores. Suggested sample prompt payload: ```json
{"input":"The capital of France is","top_k":5}
```
We can ship a docs + 1-click console action.

Lee (Renewals): ETA needed for per-route export. Customers are asking this week.

Jordan (Product PM): prioritization: Billing export = high (direct renewal impact), Retry visibility = medium (mitigates demo/regression risk), Embedding quick-check = low-medium (nice-to-have for trials). Agree?

Riley (CSM): agree. Also proposed short-term mitigation: create a templated email for CS to send to finance with instructions to match line items -> routes.

Tasha (Solutions Eng): I can draft the embedding quick-check UI and add the sample payload to docs. Low engineering lift.

Jordan (Product PM): action items: 1) Spike for billing export mapping + UX (owner: eng-billing) 2) Console/SDK toast that surfaces fallback to a cheaper variant with reason string (owner: eng-runtime) 3) Embedding quick-check doc + one-click console action (owner: docs/solutions).

Riley (CSM): @mika-bot can you open a tracker ticket for the billing export spike and tag eng-billing + finance? Need to attach the affected account list.

mika-bot: Created ticket CS-4267: "Per-route billing export + human-friendly route names" assigned to eng-billing, cc: finance. Link: https://tracker.example/CS-4267 :white_check_mark:

Lee (Renewals): thanks. I'll add the two high-risk accounts to CS-4267 and coordinate a finance sync.

Jordan (Product PM): rough ETA: toast prototype this week, billing spike scoped by next Tues, embedding quick-check doc PR in two weeks. I'll update the ticket.

Riley (CSM): perfect. I'll add a short note to the renewal playbook and send the templated email for finance matching. If anyone hears new customer quotes drop them here.
